ranking.note: With --stockfish, every child uses that engine at identical depth (no mixed label sources). Otherwise only complete local cached sets are ranked. Cached FEN matching uses the first four fields, retains en-passant, ignores clocks/history; coverage is conservative. Parents with any mate score or missing label are excluded from cp ranking/regret; mates are never mapped to invented centipawns.

leaves.note: Uniform reservoir over static evaluation events per search evaluator, including quiescence stand-pat, not terminal mate scores. Repeated positions are retained; more expensive roots contribute more events. Independent fresh TT per root/mode. Root ordering is a seeded random held-out subset. No trusted leaf targets are implied. Incoming -1 denotes root/unknown.

uncertainty.note: Null score limits mean insufficient opening clusters. Null Elo limits at score 0/1 are unbounded. Bootstrap intervals are conditional on this finite opening suite; identical cluster outcomes yield a degenerate interval. Do not infer significance from small or degenerate samples. Max-ply draws are safety adjudications.

interpretation: The frozen neural models fit clipped held-out Stockfish labels better than Classic, while the supplied depth-3 paired matches favor Classic. These are different measurements. Correction magnitudes, local changes and clipping are diagnostic observations, not proof of the cause. Sibling ranking is unavailable without complete trusted child labels.
